create_prompt_depth_anything_image_proce: create a PromptDepthAnythingImageProcessor with custom resize, padding, and normalization settings
run_image_preprocess: run the preprocess method on a batch of images with optional prompt depth maps to produce pixel values and prompt depth tensors
resize_image_with_aspect_ratio: resize an image tensor to a target size while preserving aspect ratio and constraining dimensions to a multiple
pad_image_to_divisor: pad an image tensor with center padding so its dimensions are multiples of a given size divisor
post_process_depth_estimation: post process DepthEstimatorOutput raw predictions by resizing them to target image sizes and return depth tensors
